stubs.risk_why_en: cellKbRead: game tests r3==0 (callgraph). A stub that returns 0 without writing key data looks like 'no keys'. Called in voicediag (boot). Keyboard init is logged. Unlikely to freeze the village; can break name entry.

stubs.name: cellAtracGetSecondBufferInfo
stubs.risk_why_en: Second ATRAC buffer info. Game tests r3 at both call sites (callgraph CONFIRMED). A stub that returns 0 without filling the out-struct can skip or corrupt streaming. Linked in autolink notes to the mixer / 6ch AT3P path. VERIFY with SF_HLE_LRLOG + atrac-validator.
stubs.risk_why_ar: معلومات المخزن الثاني للصوت. اللعبة تفحص الرجع، والجسم الفاضي ممكن يخرب الستريمنغ.

stubs.name: cellAtracIsSecondBufferNeeded
stubs.risk_why_en: IsSecondBufferNeeded: game branches on r3>0 vs not (callgraph CONFIRMED). A constant 0 means 'not needed' and would skip the second buffer path. Candidate for thin/wrong BGM if a second buffer is required. VERIFY by logging r3 and whether the 6ch stream requests a second buffer.
stubs.risk_why_ar: ترجع 0 يعني «ما يحتاج مخزن ثاني». إذا الأغنية تحتاجه، الصوت يخف أو يخرب.

steps.title: Log-only autotest exe with SF_HLE_LRLOG=1
steps.detail: SFRACE 19:01–19:30 already ran with SF_HLE_LRLOG (in-world stubs already counted). For the 28 still unseen: a shorter log-only boot+menus run, only when the PC is free and Saud is not playing. Use movie v5 + the existing voicediag SF_HLE_LRLOG hook (hooks/BUILD_NOTES.md), or any exe that already has that hook (1786_voicediag / SFRACE tree). Log-only, standing OK. Do not overwrite 1786_movie_v5 or PLAY_Strikeforce.bat. Optional bundle: census + lifecycle [sf-lc] + SF_ATRAC_LOG in the SAME log build (team rule 5). SF_AUTOLINK=1 skeletons are also log-only but need an include in port/stubs.cpp — only if that paste is already approved as diagnostic; otherwise LRLOG is enough.

steps.title: Run env and capture
steps.detail: On a [TEST-SALEM] window only, state under sfauto (not Saud's play save): SF_HLE_LRLOG=1. Keep stderr+stdout. After quit, run lib/coverage.py on the log and copy only numbers (unique NIDs, per-NID counts, LRs, first stage/movie) back to /workspace/sf-stubs48/pc-results/. Do not copy EBOOT or lifted code.

steps.title: Boot path (no teleport) — movies + title + OSK
steps.detail: Start the tester exe and do not skip cutscenes. This is the CONFIRMED home of cellSail GraphicsAdapterSetPreferredFormat / AddDescriptor, AudioOutSetCopyControl, cellKbRead, and (in 1817 stdout) OSK SetLayoutMode + SetInitialKeyLayout. Goal for IMPORTED-NOT-SEEN in cellSail, remaining OSK/OskExt, cellAudioOutConfigure, cellGame GetSizeKB/PatchCheck: see whether they fire before stage A. TELEPORT is not valid on the title screen (player XYZ is an in-world address).

steps.title: Enter Shu Chapter 1 village, then TELEPORT_SAVE
steps.detail: In-world stub traffic (lwcond_signal*, flip, KbRead) is already counted through SFRACE stage B. Known tester coordinates CONFIRMED in findings 19:31: start camp S = (6500, 4346, 7500), snow area 1 = (5960, 2494, 14983), written to all 8 position mirrors. checkpoints.json still has only village_x6499_partial (X only) — do not goto that one. If a later menus run needs the village/blacksmith, TELEPORT_SAVE a full XYZ once the player is standing (a write during knockdown is ignored; a single huge Z jump goes out of bounds). Do not teleport into an unloaded stage. Gate coords are still unknown.

steps.title: Menus that may reach the leftover stubs
steps.detail: On the tester profile only: open save-data menu (cellSaveDataDelete2, cellFsRmdir/Utime — do not delete Saud's real save). Open options / name-entry if the remaining OSK stubs are still unseen. Title online/trophy/friends menus for sceNp* / sceNpTus / sys_net / cellSysutilAvc2 — no real PSN login. If they still never fire after one full boot+village+menus pass, leave them IMPORTED-NOT-SEEN and do not invent a teleport.

steps.title: What this run will decide
steps.detail: For every IMPORTED-NOT-SEEN stub: first [hle-lr] line, LR, stage/movie, count from [hle-lrc]. For sys_lwcond_signal / destroy / lwmutex_destroy: counts in the 2000 lines before stage A→B and around the hang. For cellAtrac second-buffer pair and cellAudioOutConfigure: r3/r4 and whether a 6ch configure happens. Then re-run this census on the new numbers. No behaviour-change build in this plan.

exercise_hints.cellAtrac: same boot movies (6ch on movie001/007) and then village BGM. Stay in the village / blacksmith after load; no teleport required.
exercise_hints.cellGcmSys: any in-game frame (village or blacksmith). After the player is in the village, TELEPORT_SAVE to fill Y/Z, then stay put.
exercise_hints.cellResc: same as graphics: title into village, then blacksmith camera. If still unseen, dump with SF_HLE_LRLOG through the first flip.
exercise_hints.cellSysutil: OSK cluster: title / name-entry / options. 1817 already hit SetLayoutMode + SetInitialKeyLayout during boot. Re-run boot with SF_HLE_LRLOG to catch the rest (AddSupportLanguage, KeyLayoutOption, …).
exercise_hints.sys_io: cellKbRead: boot + any text prompt. Already seen in voicediag; confirm poll rate with LRLOG.
exercise_hints.cellOskExtUtility: same title / name-entry as OSK. Autolink first-hit LRs exist from older PC logs.
exercise_hints.cellGame: boot (BootCheck path). GetSizeKB / PatchCheck may only run on install/patch or first-boot without a ready cache — try a tester state with empty game-data (copy, not Saud's save).
exercise_hints.sysPrxForUser: lwcond/lwmutex: already called in voicediag if hooked. atexit/exitspawn/spu_image_close: end of process or SPU image unload — run until a clean quit, and also across a stage change (A→B).
exercise_hints.sys_fs: Rmdir/Utime: likely save-delete or cache maintenance. Try a tester-only save delete in the in-game save menu (not Saud's real save). Do not delete his save.
exercise_hints.cellSaveData: cellSaveDataDelete2: in-game save-delete on the tester profile only.
exercise_hints.cellSysutilAvc2: PS3 voice-chat APIs. Probably never reached in offline play. Optional: open any in-game 'party / voice' menu if one exists; otherwise leave as IMPORTED-NOT-SEEN.
exercise_hints.sceNp: PlayStation Network friends/events. Init already runs at boot; GetEvent / friend list may need the NP menus or a stub-online flag. Do not enable real PSN. Log-only run through the title's online/trophy menus.
exercise_hints.sceNpTus: TUS (title user storage) poll — online. Same as sceNp.
exercise_hints.sys_net: socket/bind/setsockopt/init: CELL_SYSMODULE_NET is already loaded at boot. These may run during sceNp Init. Catch with SF_HLE_LRLOG from process start. Conditional net NIDs (the other 7) are not in this stub list.
